notes.title: Demonicon is 60% off this week!
notes.content:
[b]The Dark Eye - Demonicon[/b] tells the tragic story of a brother and sister who become pawns of sinister forces in a world of cruelty and depravity. In this bleak yet magical world, their affection is both a blessing and a curse. Both are constantly threatened by mortal danger and demonic temptation, and must find a way through their tortured lives by facing serious moral decisions.
